Hi Alice / EventOps team,

Quick note — we finalized the invite HTML and the RSVP tracking matrix for the May 25 developer workshop. Attached: invite_html_v2.html (final), sponsor_logo.zip (Acme logo).

Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?
- The event platform will accept a fallback RSVP URL if our primary tracking token fails (EventOps to confirm).
- Any blacklisted domains to suppress in the send (Acme to confirm).
- Sponsor logo size check (we included retina and non-retina in sponsor_logo.zip).

Thanks — we want to lock everything before the send window starts next week.

Date: Tue, 05 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: Developer Workshop — Hosted Inference at Scale

Marissa — thanks for the assets. Confirmations below:
- We support a 3-link rotation and will honor 302 redirects for failover. Each link can have a unique expiry.
- Default TTL for ephemeral RSVP links is 30 days; we can shorten to 10 days if you prefer.
- No platform-level blocking for common corporate domains, but we can add domain suppression per your list.

One potential gotcha: our fraud engine will rate-limit identical link clicks from identical IPs if redirected more than 5x in a short window. If you rely on click replay testing, let us know and we can whitelist test IPs.

Next steps: please send the final tracking tokens and HubSpot webhook config and we’ll stage the links on our QA sandbox.

—EventOps
Ops Team
Event Platform

Nice, thank you. A few operational details from my side:

- HubSpot webhook: we will send a POST to your endpoint with the token param "rsvp_token" and payload fields: email, utm_source, uid, segment. (We’ll hand off the webhook URL in a secure note after QA.)
- Link rotation plan: tokens A/B/C mapped to segments:
  - A = "enterprise-architects" (sends from main list)
  - B = "platform-engineers" (developer nurture)
  - C = "sponsor-invite" (Acme-owned sends)
- Failover plan: if a token returns 5xx, EventOps should redirect to the next token in rotation and increment the failover counter. If 3 consecutive failovers happen, fallback to a static landing page with manual RSVP form (link included in matrix).

I’ve uploaded the current token sheet and a short QA checklist to the Drive link in related_links. Please stage the links on sandbox and ping when ready for smoke test.

-Aditya

Redwood Inference
